checks.description: C15.1: the native Deal name control starts empty and limits input to 40 UTF-16 units.
C15.2: editing a name keeps cards, progress, active time and board code unchanged.
D05 and C15.3: name, play a mismatch, wait 800ms, export, New Game and load the app text to restore the name and progress.
D05 and C08.2: unnamed exports and legacy imports keep version 1 and the original exact fields.
C15.4: a named import restores its name paused and a later legacy import clears it.
D05, D06 and D07: invalid names, missing fields, versions and version 1 state vectors are rejected inside named snapshots without changing progress.
C15.5: fresh-deal actions and reload clear names, which never enter browser preferences.
C15.2: naming paused progress keeps the pause and exact pending mismatch interval.
C15.2 and C15.4: completed progress stays static, permits renaming and clearing, and keeps the best score.
D10.1: named snapshots accept exactly 65536 UTF-8 bytes and reject one byte more.
D05: all top-level order variants, whitespace and CRLF drafts restore the same valid state as one result.
D06: selection member order has no effect for one-card and mismatch states.
D06: reordered unknown top-level members are rejected without changing progress or the draft.
D05: every missing top-level member is rejected in reordered input with progress unchanged.
D07: reordered inconsistent progress and incomplete pairs are rejected with progress unchanged.
D06: reordered nested selections still reject unknown and missing members.
D06 and D07: reordered snapshots keep every version 1 state-validation rule, including both counter caps.
C10: reordered unfinished imports ignore activation and preserve pending time until Resume.
C09 and C12: reordered completed imports stay completed without Resume or a new best.
D05: reordered named version 2 snapshots restore both the name and progress.
